title: Pinned version — items/{id}/v{n}.json
description: §8: the irrevocable per-version file. Never an endcap (§8 rule 2). Carries that version's transclusions, generated, stub_of and forked_from (§8 rule 5); no media array (§8 rule 4).

kind.description: §8 rule 2: withdrawal endcaps MUST NOT be pinned; a pinned thread carries kind thread (rule 5).

at.description: §8: publish time of the pinned version.

pinned.description: §8: always true; fork resolution checks it (§5.6 rule 2).

author.description: §8 rule 6: rides outside the pin promise; SHOULD be the assertion as published with that version.

content_md.description: §8 rule 2: only a version with content may be pinned.

transclusions.description: §8 rule 5: a pinned thread carries its transclusions provenance.

stub_of.description: §8 rule 5: a pin carries its own citations (decision #27).
